All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
HersheyFont
Hershey single-stroke vector fonts, the text engine from XYscope.java (which credits https://github.com/ixd-hof/HersheyFont).
HersheyFont.Glyph
 
Oscilloscope
The audio-to-vector half of the library: the rendering pipeline of Hansi Raber's Oscilloscope app (https://github.com/kritzikratzi/Oscilloscope), taken out of the app and packed into one class.
OsciMesh
A port of OsciMesh from Hansi Raber's Oscilloscope app, the renderer at the heart of the audio-to-vector half of the library.
StreamResampler
Streaming sample rate conversion for one channel of audio.
WavFile
A minimal, dependency-free RIFF/WAVE reader and writer.
XYBiquad
Second order filter from Robert Bristow-Johnson's Audio EQ Cookbook.
XYBitCrush
Snaps the beam to a coarse grid.
XYChannelDelay
Delays X or Y, shearing the shape and opening lines into loops.
XYDecoder
Turns XY audio back into vector shapes: XYPolylines on an XYscope-style canvas (pixels, y down).
XYDecoderSettings
How XYDecoder turns XY audio back into shapes.
XYDelayLine
A delay line read with linear interpolation, for fractional delays.
XYDrive
tanh saturation pushes shapes out towards a rounded square.
XYEcho
Ghost copies from earlier in the loop, blended in.
XYEffect
Audio effects for XY signals: the tools XYTransformer uses to turn one vector shape into another by treating the shape as sound.
XYEffectChain
Effects run in order, each over the whole buffer.
XYHighPass
AC coupling: shapes sag and smear, like a cheap sound card.
XYLowPass
Rounds corners and swallows small detail.
XYNoise
Jitter, seeded so the same settings give the same shape.
XYParameter
A named setting with a range, standing in for openFrameworks' ofParameter.
XYPlayer
Plays an XY audio file to the sound card and feeds the same audio to an Oscilloscope, which is the job OsciAvAudioPlayer did in the Oscilloscope app: one stream at the sound card's sample rate, one for the display.
XYPolyline
A run of points, open or closed, standing in for openFrameworks' ofPolyline.
XYRingMod
Multiplies by a sine: shapes pulse in and out of the center.
XYRotate
Mixes X and Y with a rotation matrix, optionally spinning.
XYSampleHold
Lowers the sample rate: steps, corners and stray dots.
XYscope
A port of XYscope.java by Ted Davis (https://teddavis.org/xyscope), by way of the ofxTwoscilloscope addon: the vector-to-audio half of the library.
XYSoundBuffer
Interleaved audio, standing in for openFrameworks' ofSoundBuffer: frame i, channel c is samples[i * numChannels + c], each from -1 to 1.
XYSoundInput
Something that takes audio buffers from an XYSoundStream, like openFrameworks' ofBaseSoundInput.
XYSoundOutput
Something that fills audio buffers for an XYSoundStream, like openFrameworks' ofBaseSoundOutput.
XYSoundStream
A sound card stream, standing in for openFrameworks' ofSoundStream, built on javax.sound.sampled so it needs no other libraries.
XYTransformer
The new feature, and the reason the two halves of the library live together: turn a vector shape into a new vector shape by passing it through sound.
XYWavefold
Folds the signal back at the edges, a kaleidoscope.
XYWavetable
A port of XYscope's XYWavetable.java, itself Hansi Raber's fix of Minim's Wavetable: a float array you can sample with a normalized [0,1] position.
